dct_description_sm: Abbreviations: Campaign (field work);	River (where the data was collected);	Sampling_Date; Season (climatic season); Latitude_N (north) and Longitude_W (west - both in Decimal degrees); Sampling_method (describes how sites were accessed); Location (along the river length);	mean_watershed_Slope_degrees; 	Watershed_area_Km	Soil_Ocstock_depth 0-30cm_t_ha-1 and Clay _content_0-5 cm_g_kg-1 (from www.soilgrids.org); Percentage of watershed area cover by different land uses (LandUse 10 Canada): 	%Unclass_vegetation (unclassified), 	%Settlement;	%Road;	%Water (surface water);	%Forest;	%Forested_wetland	%Trees	%Treed_wetland	%Cropland	%Grassland	%Wetland	%Wetland_Shrub	%Wetland_Herb	%Other;	Atm_Pressure (mmHg);	Temp_water_degreesCelsius (temperature water in situ);	 DO_mg_L (dissolved oxygen);	pH;	Cond_uS_cm-1 (water electrical conductivity);	TN_mg_L-1 (total nitrogen);	TP_ug_L-1 (total phosphorus);	DOC_mg_L-1 (dissolved organic carbon);	POM_PIM_mh_L-1 (the sum of particulate organic carbon and particulate inorganic carbon);	Color_Abs_440_nm_m-1 (coloured dissolved organic matter (m-1) as absorbance at 440nm).

This dataset contains physico-chemical water parameters as well as watershed-scale properties of several rivers flowing into the coast along the Eastern James Bay region of northern Québec. We performed water sampling in the river’s subsurface in different sections, river mouth, half-way, upstream, once during five consecutive seasons, from July 2018 to August 2019.
Data presented here is in the scope of the multidisciplinary project "The Coastal Habitat Comprehensive Research Project - Eeyou Istchee". Field operations were carried out with full consent from local land users, in collaboration with local communities and with the engagement of the Niskamoon Corporation of the Cree Grand Council.
dct_title_s: River export in the Eastern James Bay [2018-2019]
